candidates.label: Add Phaser as a parallel, selectable renderer spike
evidence: Current world-model.mjs and world-bridge.mjs already isolate the disposable visual projection from the authoritative semantic DOM.
Current SVG renderer passes deterministic world and browser tests but the displayed robot is a cropped room-scene thumbnail rather than a character sprite.
Official Phaser package metadata identifies Phaser 4.2.1, MIT, with browser and ESM distributions and eventemitter3 as its declared dependency.
Official Phaser documentation provides Scene, Camera, input, and tilemap primitives that match the requested game-like lab direction.
A query-parameter or feature-flag renderer selection preserves the validated SVG fallback until parity evidence exists.

candidates.label: Replace the SVG renderer with Phaser immediately
evidence: The current renderer boundary is narrow enough to permit replacement without changing the research witness loader.
The existing semantic DOM can remain authoritative while Phaser owns only the visual world.
Replacement is technically reversible from exact preimages, but it removes the validated fallback before Phaser parity and failure-isolation checks pass.

candidates.label: Keep the SVG prototype and defer Phaser
evidence: The existing SVG implementation is deterministic and its current focused validation passed.
Deferral avoids dependency, bundle, license-lock, CSP, and migration work, but leaves the interface visually below the requested virtual cowork RPG quality.
